checkpoints.message: Welcome to the team tour. I'll guide you across Gotham and introduce each teammate's latest update.
Sprint coordination is on track. Tasks are assigned, dependencies are visible, and the team has a clear path through the remaining work.
UI styling is nearly wrapped up. Colors, motion, and callouts are being tuned so every update stays readable on a projector.
The demo storyline and presentation flow are in place, and we're refining the most memorable moments so the walkthrough feels fun instead of flat.
Testing is focused on risky interactions. We've captured the biggest issues, fixed the blockers, and are watching for regressions.
Client feedback has been gathered and prioritized. The highest-impact requests are already folded into the next round of improvements.
Backend integration is steady. APIs are connected, the core flows are stable, and the next step is polishing edge-case handling.
Release prep is underway. The final checklist covers packaging, presentation readiness, and a smooth handoff for launch day.
